The walls are made of crumbling concrete or plaster with significant peeling paint and exposed aggregate, indicating severe decay and abandonment. Through the bars, a bright outdoor courtyard or walkway is visible, contrasting with the dark, shadowed interior. The scene conveys a sense of confinement and historical neglect.
